# 7amdi

> Personal website of 7amdi - a self-taught developer from Morocco who writes (and sometimes lies) about web development, design, performance, and experiments. Also posts notes and photos.

## About

7amdi is a self-taught web developer based in Morocco with Amazigh/Tamazight cultural roots. He works primarily with Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Prisma, and Framer Motion. He runs Fedora Linux with GNOME on a desktop setup .

Online he goes by: Mohamed, 7amdi, 74mdi, ana7amdi, 7amdi911, 7madi, qaiik .

He communicates in a mix of Darija (Moroccan Arabic), tachlhit, and English. The site's language and tone reflect that — casual, direct, multilingual.

## Site Structure

- **Home** — `https://7amdi.vercel.app/` — Introduction, social links, Last.fm music status.
- **Thoughts** — `https://7amdi.vercel.app/thoughts` — Blog/notes on programming, design, performance, and experiments.
- **Gallery** — `https://7amdi.vercel.app/gallery` — Photo gallery.
- **Guestbook** — `https://7amdi.vercel.app/guestbook` — Visitor guestbook, backed by Neon DB.

## Projects

### Koko Quran
A Quran reader web app with 74 reciters, a persistent bottom audio player, per-surah OG images, localStorage state, and static pre-rendering of all 114 surah routes.

### KompLib
An open-source component library with 2,000+ components targeting HTML, React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, Angular, Alpine.js, and Tailwind CSS. Built with Next.js 14 App Router.

### KokoTools
A browser-based utility suite with 300+ tools. Designed to run entirely client-side.

### ESP32 Projects
Cloud-connected LCD display (koko-lcd.vercel.app), a Telegram PC admin bot, and a browser-based ESP32 firmware flasher using esptool-js and the WebSerial API.

## Design Philosophy

7amdi uses a personal design system called **KOKO UI**:
- Warm dark backgrounds
- Terracotta accent color (`#c97a3a`)
- EB Garamond for headings, Inter for body text, JetBrains Mono for code and numerics
- CSS variables exclusively — no Tailwind `dark:` prefix
- Anti-"AI slop" aesthetic: minimal, human-feeling, editorially warm

## Tech Stack

Next.js 14 (App Router) · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS · Prisma · Framer Motion · Neon DB · Vercel · Fedora Linux
